UtilitiesOperatingExpenseImpairments.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Impairments

UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMaintenanceOper.description: The amount of operating expenses for the period that are associated with the utility's normal revenue producing operation; including selling, general, and administrative expenses, costs incurred for routine plant repairs and maintenance, and operations.
UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMaintenanceOper.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance, Operations, and Other Costs and Expenses

UtilitiesOperatingExpensePurchasedPower.description: Amount of operating expense for purchased power of regulated operation.
UtilitiesOperatingExpensePurchasedPower.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Purchased Power

UtilitiesOperatingExpenseTaxes.description: Amount of operating expense for taxes other than income taxes of regulated operation.
UtilitiesOperatingExpenseTaxes.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Taxes

UtilityRevenue.description: The aggregate amount of revenues for public and other utilities generated by the sale of electricity, water, gas, and other services.
UtilityRevenue.label: Electric and Gas Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChange.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for a specified deferred tax asset.
ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChange.label: Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Increase (Decrease), Amount

VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedAssets.description: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) assets, classified as current.
VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedAssets.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Current (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedAssets.description: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) assets classified as noncurrent.
VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedAssets.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedAssets.description: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) assets that do not have to be used to settle obligations of VIE.
VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedAssets.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Not Pledged (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedAssets.description: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) assets that can only be used to settle obligations of VIE.
VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedAssets.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Pledged (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedCarryi.description: The carrying amount of the consolidated Variable Interest Entity's assets included in the reporting entity's statement of financial position.
VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedCarryi.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedCarryi.description: The carrying amount of the consolidated Variable Interest Entity's liabilities included in the reporting entity's statement of financial position.
VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedCarryi.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedLiabil.description: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) liabilities classified as current.
VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedLiabil.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Current (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedLiabil.description: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) liabilities that do not have recourse to general credit of primary beneficiary.
VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedLiabil.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, No Recourse (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedLiabil.description: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) liabilities, classified as noncurrent.
VariableInterestEntityConsolidatedLiabil.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityEntityMaximumLossE.description: The reporting entity's maximum amount of exposure to loss as a result of its involvement with the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).
VariableInterestEntityEntityMaximumLossE.label: Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure, Amount

VariableInterestEntityFinancialOrOtherSu.description: The amount of financial or other support the reporting entity has provided (explicitly or implicitly) to the Variable Interest Entity (VIE) that it was not previously contractually required to provide or that the reporting entity intends to provide, including, for example, situations in which the reporting entity assisted the VIE in obtaining another type of support.
VariableInterestEntityFinancialOrOtherSu.label: Variable Interest Entity, Financial or Other Support, Amount

VariableInterestEntityNonconsolidatedCar.description: Carrying amount of the assets in the reporting entity's statement of financial position that relate to the reporting entity's variable interest in the Variable Interest Entity (VIE), where the reporting entity is not the VIE's primary beneficiary.
VariableInterestEntityNonconsolidatedCar.label: Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Carrying Amount, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityNonconsolidatedCar.description: Net carrying amount of the assets and liabilities in the reporting entity's statement of financial position that relate to the reporting entity's variable interest in the Variable Interest Entity (VIE), when the reporting entity is not the VIE's primary beneficiary.
VariableInterestEntityNonconsolidatedCar.label: Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Carrying Amount, Assets and Liabilities, Net (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableInterestEntityNonconsolidatedCar.description: Carrying amount of the liabilities in the reporting entity's statement of financial position that relate to the reporting entity's variable interest in the Variable Interest Entity (VIE), where the reporting entity is not the VIE's primary beneficiary.
VariableInterestEntityNonconsolidatedCar.label: Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Carrying Amount, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

VariableLeaseCost.description: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.
VariableLeaseCost.label: Variable Lease, Cost

WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOuts.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.
WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOuts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted

WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstanding.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.
WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstanding.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic

WriteOffOfDeferredDebtIssuanceCost.description: Write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance cost in an extinguishment of debt.
WriteOffOfDeferredDebtIssuanceCost.label: Write off of Deferred Debt Issuance Cost
